title_en: Yangwang Opens Altior China Pre-orders as GWM Details ORA 7 Body Plans
title_zh: 仰望鼎曜开启国内预订，长城披露欧拉7双车身规划
excerpt_en: Yangwang's Altior limited edition requires a RMB 300,000 deposit in China. GWM confirms coupe-style and wagon bodies for the ORA 7; both remain product developments ahead of launch or delivery.
excerpt_zh: 仰望鼎曜限量版开启国内预订，定金30万元；长城确认欧拉7提供轿跑和旅行两种车身形态。两项均为上市或交付前的产品推进动态。
html_en:
China's latest verified product updates cover executive luxury and alternative body styles. Yangwang has opened domestic pre-orders for its Altior limited edition, while Great Wall Motor has confirmed two body versions of the ORA 7. Neither update establishes a completed market launch or customer delivery.

Today's Updates

BYD's Yangwang unveiled the Altior in Abu Dhabi and opened pre-orders for the four-seat Shanhe Dingyun limited edition. Chinese customers are required to place a RMB 300,000 deposit. A five-seat version will follow outside this initial batch, and the report's expected selling price is not final. [CnEVPost]

GWM released official rear images of the ORA 7 and confirmed coupe-style and wagon versions. Autohome also reported that display cars were reaching dealerships. These disclosures describe preparations ahead of launch, rather than a completed launch or delivery. [Autohome]

Coverage and What to Watch

This short edition covers verified, previously unreported developments first disclosed during November 7–9, 2026, Beijing time. The distinction between pre-orders, showroom preparation and delivery remains central to reading these updates. AI-generated.
html_zh:
本期中国汽车市场日报的新增产品动态涉及行政豪华轿车与不同车身形态。仰望鼎曜限量版开启中国市场预订，长城则披露欧拉7轿跑版和旅行版规划。两项信息均属于正式上市或客户交付前的产品推进，预订与展车到店不能视为已经完成上市、销售或交付。

今日动态

据CnEVPost报道，比亚迪旗下仰望在阿布扎比发布鼎曜行政旗舰轿车，同时开启四座山河鼎韵限量版预订，中国市场定金为30万元。五座版本将随后推出，不属于本次首批预订范围；报道所述预计售价尚未最终确定。这里与国内经营直接相关的新进展是中国市场预订已经开启。[CnEVPost]

汽车之家报道，长城汽车发布欧拉7尾部官图，官方确认提供轿跑版与旅行版两种车身形态。报道还提到展车已陆续到店。这些信息展示了新车上市前的产品及展示准备，不能据此认定正式上市或交付已经发生。[汽车之家]

核查范围与值得关注

本期采用短版，仅收录北京时间2026年11月7日至9日期间首次公开、且本版近期未发过的已核实进展。阅读这些动态时，应继续区分预订、展车到店与实际交付的阶段。本篇为AI生成。
